metrics.label: Range of Motion
metrics.description: How much of the full curl range you used. Measures the angle between full extension (~160°) and peak contraction (~60°).

metrics.label: Control
metrics.description: How smoothly you lowered the weight. Measures wrist deceleration in the last 20% of the lowering phase.

metrics.label: Elbow Stability
metrics.description: How stationary your elbow stayed during the curl. Measures horizontal drift of the elbow joint relative to your upper arm length.

metrics.label: Shoulder Swing
metrics.description: How much your upper arm swung forward. Measures the angle between your torso and upper arm at the shoulder joint.

metrics.label: Tempo
metrics.description: Ratio of lowering time to lifting time. A 2:1 ratio means you lower twice as slowly as you lift — good for muscle growth.
